summary: Implemented the progress file-reading feature. rich/progress.py: private _ProgressReader (RawIOBase + BinaryIO) with byte-accounting read paths, seek/tell, readinto, write raising UnsupportedOperation, and owned/caller-owned close handling; private _reader_context that starts Progress, enters the reader, then stops Progress before exiting the reader; module-level open (overloads for 'r'/'rt' and 'rb') and wrap_file; Progress.open (mode normalization, buffering rules, stat for total, task create/update, text wrapper for mode 'r'/'rt') and Progress.wrap_file (task total read under lock, ValueError when no total). tests/test_progress.py: 15 new tests before the __main__ block. docs/source/progress.rst: "Reading from a file" and "Reading from a file-like object" subsections. CHANGELOG.md: one Added bullet linking PR 1759. Diff is additions only (823 insertions, 0 deletions), nothing committed. Not verified: tests, mypy, and black were not run because the instructions forbade running repository code; all checks were by reading. Some docstring Args lines exceed 88 characters, matching the existing track() docstring style.
